name: membership_grants
description: A standard role granted to a membership over the whole company or explicit branches; grants combine additively.
lifecycle: Effective from starts_at until expires_at or revoked_at; company administrators revoke grants, never delete them, and expired or revoked grants are retained for attribution.

columns.Meaning: Company of the grant; immutable (tenant key).
Standard role preset: COMPANY_ADMINISTRATOR, BRANCH_MANAGER or OPERATOR; capabilities are defined by the application.
COMPANY covers every branch, including future ones; BRANCHES covers only the listed branches.
Instant a temporary grant stops being effective; no automatic renewal.
Membership that granted it, for attribution.
Instant a company administrator revoked the grant; revocation is terminal.
columns.Null meaning: The grant has not been revoked.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A grant belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, granted_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The grantor, when present, is a membership of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The holder is a membership of the same company.
A temporary grant expires after it starts.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX membership_grants_company_id_id_key ON public.membership_grants USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that branch scopes target.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX membership_grants_membership_idx ON public.membership_grants USING btree (company_id, membership_id)
